layer1.name: Nuzzel
layer1.one_liner: A daily email of the stories most shared by the people you follow on Twitter.
layer1.description: Read your social graph rather than your timeline: Nuzzel surfaced the articles being shared by people you already followed, as a daily digest. Free, with a paid tier for media professionals. Entirely dependent on Twitter API access.
layer1.outcome_note: Discontinued after Twitter acquired its parent company. The founder wrote that it was no longer possible to sustain Nuzzel as a standalone service. A platform-dependency death — the same failure mode as GummySearch in PRD §5.5.
